label: HP EliteBook 840 G11 14-inch business laptop
description: 14-inch Core Ultra business ultrabook. Wireless is Intel Wi-Fi 6E AX211 2x2 with Bluetooth 5.3 (vPro variant also AX211) - HP lists no Wi-Fi 7 option on this sheet - and WWAN is an optional factory-fit HP 5G sub-6 Cat 19 or 4G LTE-A Pro Cat 16 module on eSIM. There is no RJ-45: HP's port list is 2x Thunderbolt 4 USB4 Type-C 40 Gbps, 2x USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A, 1x HDMI 2.1 and a headphone/mic combo jack. Ports: no Ethernet jack at all.
notes: HP moved the 840 line off the RJ45 at G9 and this G11 keeps that decision - wired needs a USB-C dock. The optional 5G WWAN is listed in the notes rather than as a wwan interface, matching how the catalogue already models the 840 G10, so the laptop does not silently appear cellular-equipped.
